scene_id_rule: VisDrone sequence prefix before the first underscore; frames of one sequence are near duplicates and share near_duplicate_group
category_scope_reason: VisDrone2019-DET annotates only the ten listed traffic categories. It labels no buildings, trees, poles, signs, street furniture or carried items, so a correct prediction of such a class is unscoreable rather than a false positive. Predictions labelled outside this scope are excluded from precision denominators and counted separately. unknown_object and entity stay in every denominator so abstention cannot buy precision.
known_limitations: Aerial drone imagery is outside assumption A4 (general photographs). No qualification is inherited or established.
Ten images and roughly 850 instances are far below the 500-image / 5000-instance panel in evaluation.md. Every gate is inconclusive by construction.
VisDrone ignored regions contain unannotated objects. Predictions inside them are still scored, so precision is pessimistic there.

The lynceus-broad-v1 ontology has no truck, bus, van, motorcycle or tricycle class. Those references accept only the broader parent 'vehicle', so label correctness is measured at a coarser granularity than the reference provides.

The baseline search profile is a single full-image pass with no tiling. Most VisDrone objects fall in the <16px and 16-32px size strata, which is what tiling (WP-06) exists to address. These numbers are the G7 baseline, not the system.
